issues.description: The solution declares the Book.title property as private (private let title: String) while Client.main (and the problem description) expects to access book.title. This visibility mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from using the book title as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book.title property non-private so it is accessible to Client and matches the problem description. For example, change 'private let title: String' to 'let title: String' (or make it internal/public as appropriate). This preserves the intended design while allowing code in Client to compile and access the title.
